answer: Locks are published in summit, expire in ferrous, and inlet lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 175 aliases hence needs 102 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2387 identities would post 3073 proofs and burn roughly 43 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
